message.text: I need to figure out fan-in for functions declared in internal/ packages. My plan is to enumerate exported functions there and then grep across the repo to count how often each is referenced elsewhere.
I'll enumerate functions declared under `internal/` and count their call sites programmatically.

args.command: cd /bench/repo && grep -rhn "^func " --include=*.go internal/ | grep -v "_test.go" | head -5; echo "=== count of internal go files"; find internal -name "*.go" -not -name "*_test.go" | wc -l

cd /bench/repo && cat > /tmp/fanin.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Collect exported and unexported func/method names declared under internal/ (non-test)
declfile=/tmp/decls.txt
> $declfile
for f in $(find internal -name "*.go" -not -name "*_test.go"); do
  grep -oE "^func (\([^)]*\) )?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*" "$f" | sed -E 's/^func (\([^)]*\) )?//' | while read -r name; do
    [ "$name" = "init" ] && continue
    echo -e "$name\t$f"
  done
done | sort -u > $declfile
wc -l < $declfile
EOF
bash /tmp/fanin.sh

cd /bench/repo && cat > /tmp/count.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# For each declared name, count call-site occurrences across all non-test go files (excluding proto/gen and web)
files=$(find . -name "*.go" -not -name "*_test.go" -not -path "./web/*" -not -path "./proto/gen/*")
while IFS=$'\t' read -r name file; do
  # count lines containing name( preceded by non-identifier char, excluding the declaration lines
  n=$(grep -hoE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.])${name}\(|\.${name}\(" $files 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  d=$(grep -hcE "^func (\([^)]*\) )?${name}\(" $files 2>/dev/null | paste -sd+ | bc)
  echo -e "$((n-d))\t$name\t$file"
done < /tmp/decls.txt | sort -rn | head -30
EOF
bash /tmp/count.sh
